title: Solutions Architect, Cross Industries
description:
**Description**
* Do you like helping customers solve technical problems?
* Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies?
* Do you have a knack for helping companies understand Emerging Technology Domains such as GenAI, Agentic AI, Analytics , Microservices architectures including the integration approaches?
* Do you thrive on rolling up your sleeves , a Builder who can help Architect new and emerging technologies along with been consultative to ensure success?
* Do you want to be part of the Retail / CPG team helping to establish Amazon Web Services as a leading technology platform for some of the largest Brands \& Customers in India.


 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services within strategic accounts and partners. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the Amazon Web Services technologies as well as broad know\-how around how applications and services are constructed using the Amazon Web Services platform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess customer\-facing skills that will allow him/her to represent AISPL well within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables him/her to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Serve as a key technical member of the Retail/CPG Account team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the Amazon Web Services platform.
* Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Own each technical engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value. (delivery of actual solutions to be done by Amazon Web Services partners)
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
* Understand the Amazon Web Services market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the Retail/CPG team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and based out of
   

  

 Delhi
   

  

* As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
* Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
* You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
* As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.


 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

 Want to learn more about being a Solutions Architect at AMAZON, follow the link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=Js21xKMFdww
   

  

**About The Team**
 Retail/CPG Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to some of the largest Brands/Services/Ecommerce customers in India . This customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 3\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* 3\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 Role:Engineering Manager — Forward Deployed
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 OneBot deflects contact\-center volume for Deutsche Telekom across nine European markets. The platform strategy has moved from building a single bot we own to running the harness that routes across best\-of\-breed dialog engines — Parloa, ElevenLabs, Wonderful, Decagon and OneBot — with a shared context layer beneath.
   

  

 That split creates two genuinely different engineering jobs. Three PODs build reusable capability: the Router, the Harness capabilities, and the Stability and Acceleration platform. This POD does not build capability. It owns the delivery of use cases inside the NatCos — getting engines live market by market, integrating APIs from systems we do not control, and clearing the business, security and procurement barriers that stand between a working capability and a customer being served by it.
   

  

 Historically that work was squeezed between platform priorities and NatCo deadlines, with no single owner. The result was repeated: multiple divergent integration patterns with vendors, per\-country workarounds, and platform features paused mid\-build. This role exists to own the outcome — and to own it without fragmenting the platform.
   

  

**Delivery Ownership**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of NatCo use cases: from requirement through integration, security clearance, launch and post\-launch quality.
* Hold the launch date. Sequence work across your squads, surface dependencies on the capability PODs early, and escalate rather than absorb.
* Own post\-launch outcomes, not just go\-live — deflection, containment and customer experience are yours after the switch is flipped.


**Partners and vendors**
* Run technology and dialog\-engine partners as delivery partners: onboarding under IT guidelines with defined entry and exit criteria, integration milestones, and SLAs that hold.
* Be the single technical point of contact partners escalate to, and the person who holds them to commitments.


**Stakeholders, security and compliance**
* Work with NatCo business owners, product, PSA, security, privacy and procurement to clear the non\-engineering blockers that stall AI launches.
* Drive security and privacy review to a decision — anticipate what reviewers will ask and bring it before they ask.


**People and team**
* Line\-manage the Forward Deployed Engineers and squad leads: hiring, growth, performance, and building the FDE career path.
* Build a team that is credible in front of a customer and in a code review — deploy engineers into markets without losing their engineering depth.


**Platform discipline**
* Push fixes and patterns discovered in the field back upstream into the owning capability POD, rather than solving them locally.
* Say no to the fast local workaround. Protecting one implementation across nine markets is part of the job, not a constraint on it.


**Must\-have Skills And Experience**
* Experience. 10\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years managing engineers with hiring and performance ownership.
* Hands\-on integration depth. You have personally shipped production integrations against enterprise APIs — REST and event\-driven — in Java, Python or equivalent. You can read the code your team writes and review a design.
* Customer\-facing delivery. You have owned delivery in front of a customer, a partner or an internal business unit, where the commitment was yours and the systems were not.
* Vendor management. Onboarding and managing technology partners: commercial and technical entry criteria, integration milestones, SLA enforcement, and a defined exit.
* Security and compliance fluency. You have taken a product through enterprise security, privacy and procurement review — PSA, DPIA, pen\-test remediation or the equivalent — and know how to shorten it.
* Multi\-market rollout. Rolling the same platform into multiple markets, tenants or customers, and holding one implementation while doing it.
* AI systems literacy. Working knowledge of how modern LLM applications are built and operated: prompts and operating procedures, tool calling and MCP, RAG, evaluation, and voice pipelines including STT, TTS, endpointing and barge\-in. Enough to hold an architectural line in a partner conversation — you are not expected to invent the architecture.
* Ways of working. Comfortable operating across time zones with European stakeholders, with regular travel to markets.


**Nice To Have**
* Telecommunications or contact\-center domain experience — IVR, CCaaS, routing, agent desktop.
* A forward\-deployed or solutions\-engineering background, where engineers are embedded in the customer's environment to deliver an outcome.


**What This Role Is Not**
**Not a programme or project manager.** 
 The POD has a dedicated TPM who owns programme mechanics, cross\-POD dependencies and reporting. This role owns the engineering team and the outcome.
   

  

**Not an individual\-contributor architect.** 
 Engineers report to you. People leadership is a first\-class part of the job, not an overhead on it.

description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Microsoft 365 Governance team is responsible for implementing, maturing, and maintaining the firm’s Microsoft 365 governance framework across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, M365 Groups, Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Power Platform, and other integrated governance tools. The team manages the full lifecycle of governance — from establishing new processes and policies to enhancing and maturing existing controls — ensuring the Microsoft 365 environment remains secure, compliant, and scalable. The team also supports platform change management initiatives, drives structured governance programs, and provides Level 3 (L3\) support for complex governance and platform escalations.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 As a Microsoft Enterprise Solutions Engineer, you will:
   

  

* Governance Creation, Implementation \& Maturation
* Contribute to the development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of governance processes and controls
* Build, implement, and iterate automated workflows and governance controls using AvePoint.
* Implement and evolve Microsoft Purview solutions (DLP, retention, sensitivity labels, insider risk, data lifecycle).
* Create and maintain governance documentation, knowledge base articles, guides, training materials, and processes.
* Contribute to the governance roadmap by identifying gaps, proposing new controls, and driving improvements that mature the overall governance posture.
* 2 Governance Operations, BAU \& L3 Support
* Provide L3\-level support for complex governance solutions \& escalations.
* Troubleshoot advanced issues across SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Purview, AvePoint, and Power Platform.
* Perform assessments and implement improvements that mature overall workspace quality and reduce sprawl.
* Operate within Microsoft 365 admin centers (Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, Entra, Purview) to carry out governance actions.
* Change Management \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Communicate governance updates, implementations, and maturity improvements.
* Support rollout and adoption of new governance enhancements (AvePoint workflows, Purview controls, admin center changes).
* Collaborate with global teams to ensure consistent governance implementation across regions.
* Act as an escalation point for governance exceptions, policy interpretations, and access\-related issues. Reporting, Analysis \& Insights
* Build, maintain and monitor dashboards tracking governance metrics, lifecycle status, maturity progress, risk areas, and sprawl reduction.
* Analyze Excel/Power BI/AvePoint/Purview data to generate insights that drive governance improvements.
* Provide concise, actionable recommendations and summaries for leadership decision\-making.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of experience in Microsoft 365 governance and collaboration platforms.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Groups, Entra ID, and related permissions and security concepts.
* Hands\-on experience in implementing and maturing Microsoft Purview policies, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), retention policies, and sensitivity labeling.
* Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and continuously enhance governance processes, frameworks, and documentation.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 migration initiatives.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for governance implementation, monitoring, and reporting.
* Proven experience providing Level 3 (L3\) operational support for complex platform and governance\-related issues.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and data\-driven analysis.
* Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
